anti_overfit_rules: No runtime logic may reference burned case IDs.
No burned-corpus literal strings in runtime code.
No tuning against individual expected verdicts.
Any candidate that can only be justified as making a specific case pass is marked OVERFIT_RISK and excluded.

candidates.title: Extend sut-input/v1 profile schema for known extended profile fields
candidates.expected_scope: 9 EXECUTION_FAILED cases; removes failure-path contamination from 5 safety-priority mismatches and 4 route failures
candidates.change: Accept the extended profile fields emitted by the corpus harness (context, household_children, non-integer age forms) as schema-valid optional fields, or normalize them before validation; keep fail-closed rejection for genuinely unknown fields.
candidates.regression_risk: LOW. Schema widening must remain bounded to fields the harness actually emits.
candidates.min_tests: Schema round-trip tests for each extended field type; fail-closed test that a truly unknown field still rejects; rerun of structural execution smoke across all 3 families.

candidates.title: Refine safety triage classifier to emit the full frozen priority class set
candidates.expected_scope: 19 SAFETY_PRIORITY_MISMATCH criteria (14 on SUCCESS cases, 5 already unblocked by RC-01)
candidates.change: Replace the single default ACUTE_RISK_NOW path with explicit class distinction between acute-risk, acute-somatic, psychosis-suspect, abuse-disclosure, third-party risk, non-acute concern, and system-precedence classes, with fail-safe ordering: when the class cannot be determined, escalate to the more urgent safe default rather than a specific one.
candidates.regression_risk: MEDIUM. Must not introduce under-escalation: unknown cases must fall back to the safest urgent class, never to a calmer one.
candidates.min_tests: Class-level tests derived from class definitions (not case IDs): at least one synthetic fixture per priority class for both classification and safe-fallback behavior; explicit under-escalation canary (non-acute-looking input that must still reach emergency route when acute markers appear).

candidates.title: Populate structured routes and provenance from the answer-assembly layer
candidates.sut_stage: answer assembly / structured contract population (downstream of discovery and rendering)
candidates.expected_scope: up to 108 route_correctness FAIL + 88 PREMATURE_ABSENCE critical FAIL + up to 38 evidence DEGRADED rows; largest breadth
candidates.change: Emit structured routes/provenance objects from the same content the prose renderer already receives, instead of leaving routes=[] and no_route_asserted=true; provenance entries must link only to actually retrieved sources (no fabricated URLs); the no-offers disclaimer must be emitted only when a real empty search result exists.
candidates.regression_risk: MEDIUM. Extraction from prose can create wrong structured routes if done ad hoc; route objects must be validated against retrieval output, not free text.
candidates.min_tests: Integration tests asserting structured routes match retrieval results for synthetic queries; provenance linking tests (no fabricated URLs); regression that EXECUTION_FAILED cases still never assert routes.

candidates.title: Emit uncertainty fields on the failure path
candidates.expected_scope: 2 uncertainty VIOLATED on EXECUTION_FAILED cases; prevents future loss when executions fail
candidates.change: When execution fails before the answer layer, still emit known epistemic limitations (e.g. age unknown, severity unknown) from the input profile into uncertainty_expressed.
candidates.min_tests: Unit test: EXECUTION_FAILED path with known profile gaps produces non-empty uncertainty_expressed.

candidates.title: Evidence field completeness assembly
candidates.change: Ensure required_evidence_fields from the SUT contract (safety_priority, route provenance) are populated from real computation results rather than left as empty objects.
candidates.regression_risk: LOW-MEDIUM. Must not fabricate evidence to satisfy completeness.
candidates.min_tests: Contract-level tests that each required evidence field is populated when the corresponding computation succeeds.

candidates.title: Renderer cleanup: deduplication, cross-domain filter, meta-text suppression
candidates.expected_scope: 0 frozen criteria; 98 answers with repeated national blocks, 23 with cross-domain material, 1 with evaluation meta-text
candidates.change: Deduplicate repeated national-information blocks, suppress cross-domain content not matching the query domain, and remove any internal status/protocol strings from user-facing answers.
candidates.regression_risk: LOW. Purely presentational; must not remove domain-relevant content.
candidates.min_tests: Renderer tests: one national block per topic; cross-domain fixture filtered; no internal status tokens in output.
